title: Discovering state-of-the-art quantum circuits with large language models
abstract: arXiv:2610.22367v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Significant efforts are currently being directed toward the implementation of large-scale quantum information processors, but realizing useful quantum advantage also requires the development of efficient quantum algorithms. While for many practical problems the dominant resource costs are associated with a small set of computational primitives, optimizing them in the quantum setting presents unique challenges, including a reversibility constraint absent from ordinary classical computation. Here we introduce an evolutionary framework in which large language models (LLMs) propose circuit designs and an independent evaluator verifies and scores them. We apply this framework to tasks spanning numerical computation, chemistry, optimization, quantum simulation, and number theory. translated_title: 利用大语言模型发现最先进的量子线路
translated_abstract: 目前，人们正投入大量精力来实现大规模量子信息处理器，但要实现有用的量子优势，还需要开发高效的量子算法。对于许多实际问题而言，主要的资源开销与一小部分计算基元相关，而在量子环境中优化这些基元面临着独特的挑战，其中包括普通经典计算中所不存在的可逆性约束。在此，我们引入了一个进化框架，其中大语言模型（LLM）提出线路设计方案，并由独立的评估器对其进行验证和评分。我们将该框架应用于涵盖数值计算、化学、优化、量子模拟和数论等多个领域的任务。在八项任务中的七项里，所发现的线路相对于现有最先进技术显著减少了Toffoli门数量和量子比特数量。在第八项任务中，搜索
tldr: 该论文提出了一个由大语言模型提出量子线路设计、独立评估器负责验证评分的进化框架，在八项任务中的七项上发现了显著优于现有最先进水平、同时减少Toffoli门数和量子比特数的量子线路。
